question.text: Can maintained Python encode_char_offsets Original/Char alignment be the trusted source of original spans without decoder inversion?
question.answer: Conditionally plausible trusted API basis, not independently established correct/approved. Maintained alignment is independent of decoding; exact runtime and per-input path/postconditions need a versioned reviewed trust contract.

sourceFacts.fact: Per-normalized-byte original intervals plus original_shift; normalized ranges expand to original first.start/last.end, potentially many-to-one.
Selected Replace maps one ASCII-space scalar to one U+2581 scalar; replacement UTF8 bytes inherit source interval. Scalar cardinality is not byte cardinality.
prepend transforms first normalized scalar; prepended marker and retained first scalar may share original first-character alignment, not necessarily a zero-length virtual range.

Added matches slice aligned NormalizedStrings and attach local token intervals; attached tokens skip later split. Remaining pieces independently normalize/pretokenize; normalize Result is not propagated at added_vocabulary550.

Normalized token bytes convert to shifted original bytes then Char indices; map_or/unwrap_or fallback can retain unconverted offsets. BytesToChar maps interior bytes to scalar index; char intervals alone do not certify scalar-byte boundaries.
BPE byte fallback emits length1 entries only when all needed byte IDs exist. Original Char conversion can collapse contributions; overlap/zero/UNK stay blocked initially.

designObligations: Root declares trust boundary: maintained Original/Char API versus decoder inverse, exact pinned pipeline/runtime/text identities; wheel-source reproducibility unresolved.
Validate all-token/special/attention/ID contract; no non-special contributor discarded or offset repaired.
Positive bounded ordered disjoint original Char intervals; complete scalar coverage or separately reviewed exact-whitespace-only coverage rule.
Independent original scalar→UTF8/UTF16 tables and IPC exact-source binding; check all endpoints, no normalization/surrogate splitting.
Address silent conversion fallbacks/trusted-path assumptions explicitly: bounds/disjointness/coverage alone are not proof of correct attribution.
Literal U+2581/UNK/control/overlap/repeats/zero/partial/unsupported/provenance/path/overflow remain blocked. No byte grouping in initial narrowv2.

Pure source-derived mechanical examples first; separately reviewed frozen actual structural test required before future model use. Old v1false staysfalse.
